title: Cantilever: natural frequencies
sentence: A clamped-free steel beam with a rectangular section — four bending frequencies from one modal Step, two in each plane.
theory: For a clamped-free beam, $f_n = \dfrac{\beta_n^2}{2\pi}\sqrt{\dfrac{EI}{\rho A L^4}}$ with $\beta_1 = 1.8751$ and $\beta_2 = 4.6941$. The $50 \times 25\,\mathrm{mm}$ section has a different $I$ about each axis, so the two planes give four distinct frequencies rather than degenerate pairs. A consistent-mass finite element model is stiffer than the real beam, so every computed frequency converges from above.
